scenario: Keywords enumerated explicitly per LGRA.15.3 — `schema`, `rule`, `where`, `emit`, `log`, `call` etc. are class-1 hard keywords; future-reserved words are listed in LLEX.9.1.6. A rule using several class-1 keywords compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > 0
->
